text:
Marathon Petroleum stock edged up 0.89% today after climbing nearly 9% over the past two weeks, riding a wave of oil price volatility tied to the Iran conflict. US crude has traded above $97 per barrel while refineries operate at near-capacity (97.8%), supporting margins for a refiner like this one. The stock's recent strength accelerated sharply on September 9th when oil prices spiked above $100 following escalating attacks on Saudi infrastructure, though Friday's retreat on peace hopes trimmed some gains.

The underlying support for refiners right now is the supply disruption premium baked into oil prices — Saudi Arabia's East-West pipeline shutdown and Houthi missile strikes have tightened crude availability and pushed prices higher, widening the profit spread between crude input costs and refined product sales. Whether that holds depends on whether the geopolitical tensions ease as some officials suggest, or worsen.
